detailed_description:
The video takes place in one late-night office. Cool monitor light and a warm desk lamp illuminate the characters. The camera has a gentle handheld documentary feel. Perform the Mandarin dialogue with quick, natural comedic timing and distinct, non-overlapping speaker turns.

[Shot 1] From 00:00.000 to 00:04.000, a medium shot shows <Subject 1> (S1) seated at his computer, studying it with a serious expression. Code scrolls on the monitors, but no characters are legible. Soft typing is audible. He calmly says, <d>[Mandarin] DeepSeek，帮我省点钱。</d>

[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, cut closer to the desk and monitor. <Subject 2> (S2) enters with coffee and lightly sets the cup down. <Subject 3> peeks up beside the desk, proudly holding a small card whose front reads exactly “算力省下来了”; her whale tail wiggles. <Subject 2> checks her phone and says with amusement, <d>[Mandarin] 网友封你梁圣了。</d> <Subject 1> straightens up and replies with mock modesty, <d>[Mandarin] 低调，叫梁叔。</d>

[Shot 3] At 00:08.000, <Subject 1> glances at a simple expense chart without readable labels and begins to relax. A phone notification chimes. <Subject 2> reads, <d>[Mandarin] 谷段结束，恢复峰价。</d> His smile freezes. <Subject 3> (S3) grins and adds, <d>[Mandarin] 白天梁文峰，半夜梁文谷。</d>

[Shot 4] At 00:12.000, <Subject 3> flips the same card over; its back reads exactly “梁子”. <Subject 2> delivers the setup, <d>[Mandarin] 梁圣只是个档位。</d> <Subject 1> covers his face and answers, <d>[Mandarin] 滑动变祖器啊！</d> All three laugh. Cut to the monitor's scrolling, illegible code as their laughter continues to 00:15.000.

Only the two specified card faces contain readable on-screen text. No subtitles, other readable text, logos, narration, or additional characters.

overall_soundscape:
Quiet computer fan and soft keyboard typing under the scene; a light cup-on-desk sound in [Shot 2], one phone notification chime in [Shot 3], and shared laughter at the end. Dialogue remains clear and never overlaps.
